name: @natlang/task-author
description: Author semantic training tasks: draft a task with its oracle, repair structural problems, and admit it only when it is genuinely semantic and its oracle holds.

task-author.description: Author and qualify a Semantic-FP training task from a seed JSON file or stdin.

arguments.name: file
arguments.description: Path to a JSON file containing a TaskSeed (or { seed, reservedGroups?, attempts?, escalateTo? }).
